extracted.name: Best Guacamole Recipe
extracted.description: The BEST guacamole recipe! It's easy to make with simple, fresh ingredients. Serve it as a dip with tortilla chips or with Tex Mex and Mexican dishes like tacos, burritos, and more.
ingredient_lines: ¼ cup finely chopped fresh cilantro
½ teaspoon sea salt (plus more to taste)
optional: 1 to 2 Roma tomatoes (seeded and diced)
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, combine the avocados, onion, cilantro, lime zest and juice, jalapeño, salt, and cumin, if using. Mash until the ingredients are combined but still a bit chunky.
Fold in the tomatoes, if using.
